mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.25% for three consecutive months, it signals a shift from emergency policy to neutral stance, triggering economic slowdown expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.25% for 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal sustained residential demand that correlates with elevated corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate consistently signals improving labor market conditions that increase household income and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 9.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates labor market overheating that may trigger inflationary pressures and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 9.0% for 2 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust economic activity across manufacturing and residential sectors, correlating with rising corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO and HOUST both rise, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In supply-constrained regimes where industrial production growth is below 0.5% annually, a sudden acceleration in INDPRO signals resolution of supply bottlenecks, improving corporate margins and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during supply-constrained regimes when INDPRO accelerates, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.
